strings.report_title: ✅  WOŊLƆ FAEL LA ƉE TAME AHATUTU E
strings.report_limits:
• NTFS nyatakaka bubu (ADS) womewɔa dɔ le wo ŋu o.
• USN agbalẽwɔwɔ womeklɔnɛ o.
• Vɔvɔli kpɔɖeŋuwo kple alilikpowo ƒe ƒoƒo ɖekae
  (OneDrive kple bubuwo) medze wo ŋu o.
strings.status_full: Emee nuwo katã woŋlɔ wo ɖe tame kple zero. Mmate ŋu agbugbɔe o — dɔwɔnuwo akpɔ zero ko.
strings.status_fast: Ta, ƒe kple 4 MB fli woŋlɔ wo ɖe tame. Nu siwo susɔ mekɔ o, gake le ɣeƒeƒoƒo ta la, gbugbɔgbɔ katã to asitsalawo ƒe dɔwɔnuwo me mate ŋu anɔ anyi o. Ne ɖe nye nuɣaɣla nuŋlɔɖiwo la, zã MƆDZƆ̃ KATÃ.
strings.status_empty: Fael la nɔ ƒuƒu, ŋlɔɖe tame mehiã o. Wotutue.
strings.error_permission: Nyemate ŋu aɖe fael la o. Ðewohĩ eʋu le dɔwɛna bubu me. Tre e eye nàgadze agbagba ake.
strings.error_not_found: Womekpɔ fael la o. Ðewohĩ wotutue xoxo.
strings.error_is_symlink: Esia nye dzesi kadodo. Womate ŋu agblẽ kadodo o — fael si woyi ɖo la anɔ anyi ɖoɖoe.
strings.error_reparse: Esia nye teƒe fael (OneDrive alo eɖeɖe). Eƒe nyatakaka le alilikpo me, menye le disiki dzi o — nu aɖeke mele teƒe sia gblẽ ge o.
strings.error_not_file: Esia menye fael o (gbalẽdu alo bubu). Ði fael ɖi.
strings.error_hardlinks: Fael sia le kadodo sesẽ bubuwo si ({n} katã). Kadodo sesẽwo mele dɔ si woɖo ŋu o — ŋkɔwo katã sɔ. Ne ègblẽe to mɔ si le fifia dzi la, nyatakakawo aŋlɔ ɖe tame eye woalã wo ɖe 32 byte, gake susɔ la anɔ anyi to kadodo bubuwo dzi. Tutu kadodo katã gbã.
strings.error_compressed:
Fael la wokɔe, woɣlae alo ewe. Ŋlɔɖe tame kple zero metsɔ nu gblẽa xoxo nyatakakawo o elabena NTFS dzra wo ɖo le mɔ bubu nu.

Ɖe dzesi la ɖa: zɔ kpaɖeɖe → Dzesiwo → Ŋgɔyiyi → ɖe dzesi "Kɔe" kple/aló "Ɣla" ɖa. Ekema gawɔ SHREDDER ake.
